method: Mechanical filesystem search across the repository for the 5 locked rarity frame masters (find with case-insensitive name patterns for common/uncommon/rare/epic/legendary combined with 'frame', plus a broader search for any 'rarity' or card/asset directories). No file contents were opened or assumed.
summary: 0/5 locked rarity frame masters are currently present in this repository. No 'frame', 'rarity', or card-asset directory of any kind was found under any searched path. This is a factual finding, not an assumption - the masters are still only external/prepared (per the task's own framing) and have not been committed here.
impact_on_raw_art_production_plan: None. Per explicit instruction, frame composition is a separate, later pipeline stage (see production_rollout_policy_v1.json's frame_and_final_card_pipeline_plan) - the absence of frame masters does not block generating, technically validating, or visually QA-ing raw artwork under this queue. It only means the crop/overlay/final-card-asset stages cannot be built or tested yet.
